title: explainer/v1
description: The YAML front matter of nodes/<id>/explainer/<hash>.md (F20-R2; D-3 v3.17, v3.30): prose about one merged proof artifact of the node. Sections are level-2 headings and may name outline steps as {steps: s3 s4.1} at the end of the heading (F20-Q2). An explainer filed before this schema carries no such front matter and stays valid, unanchored. Exactly one of author and drafter is set. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

proof.description: SHA-256 of the merged artifact described: the node's Proof.lean, an alternate, or a merged partial assembly.

supersedes.description: The hash of the version this one replaces — the head of its chain, never one already superseded or withdrawn (D-3 v3.30); null to start a chain.

author.description: The login or pseudonym that wrote this version; null for a draft (then drafter is set).

drafter.description: Set for a draft by the network's drafter (D-3 v3.30), with no human author: its name, the model and version that wrote the text, and the commit of the graph its input was read at.
